title: Kanmani Anbudan
episodeTitle: Kanmani and Anbu File for Divorce
description: Anbu plans to create a moment with Kanmani at court while Kanmani tells her family about the divorce. Despite both filing their cases, Kanmani remains firm.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ranjitham's theft leaves Ilamathi helpless when Dandapani's men arrive for the interest. Dandapani threatens to confine her in his house until the dues are paid.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Karna quietly probes Sudar for information during her visit to Mahesh's house, but she cleverly conceals her past in jail. Captivated by Parvathy's diary, Sudar takes it with her.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: The news that Raji is not pregnant leaves both families heartbroken. Raji and Kathir quietly feel relieved, as they are not yet ready for parenthood.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Cheran's family boards a train to Bihar, determined to unite Cheran with Chandayatha. Nila reassures a worried Cheran that fate will bring them together.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Trusting Arun's transformation, Muthu and Meena reunite Seetha with him. Vijaya explains Nachiyar's condition to Manoj and the hardships of caring for her.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Actress Radha joins Aadi Thiruvizha for a grand Divine Round. Meanwhile, the contestants captivate the crowd with divine acts and expert judge feedback.
